name: python-count-min-sketch
title: Count-min sketch
blurb: How many times did this item arrive, from a fixed amount of memory? The sketch answers with a number and the error it may carry: collisions can only add, so an estimate is never below the truth, and the overestimate is bounded by e/width of the total. The same skewed stream is measured at five widths, two halves are shown to merge exactly into one pass, and the conservative update is compared against the plain one on the identical data instead of being credited on faith.
default_description: A count-min sketch that prints its error bound beside every estimate and proves it on a stream with a known truth.
